reviews.text: What a great visit to the Leifeng Pagoda and to see the actual foundation from years ago still preserved under the actual building. Walking up every floor and walking around all the art work, sculptures and woodworks. The amount of detail in everything is just amazing. The view from the top floor of the West Lake were just stunning. We even walked around the area and found another smaller building own a few bronze animals guarding the enterance.

One of the most amazing wood carving 6 x panles I have ever seen. The ruins of the original structure at the boot was amazing. Greatt views from the top. The history and romance of the white and green snake ladies is legenadary.

This location has several interesting areas to visit. There is the large tower with the escalator and glass elevator to take you to the panoramic city view. Then there is the lake with the house boats, tranquil setting amongst the many acres of Willow trees. This is a fantastic park where you can spend the whole day and just be surrounded by beauty.

Leifeng Pagoda offers a beautiful blend of history, legend, and sweeping West Lake views. The modern reconstruction is thoughtfully designed, with exhibits that explain the tower’s past and its connection to the Legend of the White Snake. The panoramic lookout decks are the highlight—perfect for photos and appreciating Hangzhou’s scenery. Although it can get crowded, the experience is still peaceful and culturally rich. A worthwhile stop for anyone visiting West Lake.
Beautiful pagoda with famous white snake love story. Another must visit in West lake area.

The view from up here was spectacular. Each step towards the top of the pagoda transforms you into a wiser human being. You learn that when you walk, you will be tired. When you sit, you will get bored.
Incredible! Views as you go up the tower get better and better. There’s an elevator to go up, what makes it very convenient.

About a 5-10min walk from the entrance of 苏堤. Will pass by a Starbuck and a Chinese restaurant. Entrance fee to the tower is CNY40 per person. Going up the first level is the remains of the old tower. The stairs to the 2nd floor is on the left of the tower when you go up stairs toward the tower. From the 2nd floor you can take lift of stair up the tower. There is long queue for the lift, and the lift does not go to the top floor. You will still need to take the stairs for to the top floor. The view at the top is good, but a little crowded even on weekday. You get an all round view of West Lake and it’s breezy. Went on summer, so was especially nice to take a short break to enjoy the view and cool down.

There is an elevator to make your hike sweat-less. Must visit if you are in hangzhou! It’s big and chill garden that you can take photo. Important tips: girl !don’t wear overalls cause they only have squatting toilet and bring tissue with you cause you need to pay for the toilet paper

This is a must-visit place in Hangzhou. It is at West Lake area. We were able to go despite the traffic around West Lake that day. It was a holiday when we did our tour and there were a lot of visitors- local and tourists alike. Good thing we decided to go. It is a beautiful place and the walk up was not that tiring. It has a long escalator from the bottom to the base of the pagoda then an elevator/ lift going up to the top. The view from above is breathtaking. You can see the whole West Lake area from there. The walls depict the ancient art of China. The ceiling has a beautiful design too. Overall it was worth the climb 😊

Foreigners bring passport to purchase tickets. Grand and Beautiful rebuild. The old pagoda was burned and robbed by the pirates of neighbouring country and collapse. Which the remains are within the rebuild pagoda. Closes at 7pm. Check with staffs.
Can buy ticket at the front door. very nice view up there and garden to walk around
You should visit here when you are in Hangzhou. 1st and 2nd floor are old temple relics. Using elevator to go up the highest, you will see the best view of west lake

I walked one round around xihu lake to visit Yue fei temple first before settling at leifeng pagoda. The closing time is 5.30pm. Buy your tickets early during the day to avoid the queue. Not recommended to book few days in advance since if you are walking along xihu lake, you may feel too tired. There is escalator to go up temple ground but coming down is the stairs. Going up the pagoda have both lifts and stairs. The view at the top is amazing! Love it!
Perched on top of a hill - the Leifeng Pagoda - offers a captivating sight especially when viewed from the West Lake minutes after sunset and especially during Blue Hour

The Leifeng Pagoda in Hangzhou is a mesmerizing testament to both ancient history and modern marvels. This iconic structure, reconstructed in 2002, rises majestically on the shores of the West Lake, its silhouette gracing the skyline with elegance. The pagoda's architectural grandeur, adorned with intricate carvings and vibrant paintings, reflects the rich cultural tapestry of China. Ascending the pagoda unveils panoramic views of Hangzhou's enchanting landscapes, creating an immersive experience for visitors. The surrounding gardens add to the allure, providing a serene environment for contemplation. The pagoda's historical significance, intertwined with legends dating back to the Tang Dynasty, adds a layer of mystique to the visit. The innovative use of technology is another highlight, as the pagoda houses a fascinating underground museum that showcases relics and artifacts, offering a comprehensive journey through time. The combination of tradition and modernity makes the Leifeng Pagoda a multifaceted attraction, appealing to history enthusiasts, art lovers, and those seeking a harmonious blend of cultural richness and contemporary exploration. Overall, the Leifeng Pagoda is not merely a structure but a living testament to China's cultural heritage, inviting visitors to immerse themselves in the beauty of its architecture, legends, and the picturesque surroundings of Hangzhou's West Lake.
No. 1 attraction in Hangzhou. Come here for sunset 🌅 to have a stunning overlook of west lake.
My photos are views from the top. The wooden carvings in the pagoda are beautiful. It is about white snake legend

Scenery is of course great! The troublesome thing is you can't didi at the area due to traffic control. You can only hope onto the taxis that are queueing up for passengers to hop on. Honestly, the pricing for taxi and didi are abt the same.

Leifeng Pagoda is a 5-storey tower with eight sides, located on the Sunset Hill south of the West Lake in Hangzhou. Originally constructed in the year AD 975, it collapsed in 1924 but was rebuilt in 2002. Since then, it has become a popular tourist attraction and true enough, on the day of our visit, it was super crowded with a long queue entering it. It is within the premise of Jing Ci Temple. The Leifeng Pagoda is associated with a touching love story between a white snake spirit and a mortal man. Legend has it that a white snake and a green snake took on the appearance of beautiful ladies after acquiring the supernatural powers over thousands of years. They were named Bai Suzhen and Xiao Qing. One day when they were visiting West Lake, it suddenly rained. Fortunately, they met a scholar named Xu Xian on the Broken Bridge. He lent his umbrella to them. Xu Xian and Bai Suzhen fell in love with each other at first sight. Soon, they were married. However, Evil Monk Fa Hai imprisoned Xu Xian so as to separate this couple. Bai Suzhen tried hard to save her husband by using her power. But all her efforts were in vain, and she was imprisoned under the Leifeng Pagoda. Driven by anger and sadness, Xiao Qing tried her utmost to improve her supernatural power. Finally, she beat the Evil Monk Fa Hai, tore down the tower, and saved Bai Suzhen and Xu Xian. From then on, Bai Suzhen and Xu Xian lived together happily. So romantic!

The top of the pagoda offers the best view onto West Lake, in my opinion. It's easy of access with all the escalators outside and the elevators inside the building. The inside itself is not that interesting, being of more recent construction; the ruins of the original structure are under a glass display. There are also many paths outside leading to small pavilions, steles, rocks with inscriptions, etc.

The white snake legend (Bai Zhu Chen). Remember 25 years ago when I'm young. So romantic and make me memorable.

Great view from the tower. Access by escalator and lift. Very considerate staff. They can arrange elderly golf cart to avoid the stairs.

They rebuild it at 2002 ,modern building with escalator outside and lift inside the building. You still can see the debris from the previous building. The most fascinating is woods crafted beautifully with the story of white snake legend. It is crafted very detail, the figure,trees,clouds looks alive. Really softisticated hand carving. Nonetheless, it remains a compelling cultural and scenic destination.

chùa được xây dựng năm 975 và ngày 25/9/1924, tòa tháp bị sụp đổ vì theo thời gian, các kiến trúc và kết cấu trong chùa dần bị cũ dần. Nhưng đến nay Tháp Lôi Phong đã được chính quyền cũng như người dân tu sửa và khôi phục trên chính nền chùa ban đầu. Mặc dù được xây dựng trên lớp đổ nát, nhưng Lôi Phong Tháp vẫn giữ lại được cấu trúc kiểu các gian của ngôi chùa cũ trước khi nó bị thiêu rụi. Và hoàn toàn xây dựng theo phong cách và thiết kế của thời Nam Tống.

舊的雷鋒塔在1924年莫名其妙地倒塌了，現在這個雷鋒塔是在2002年正式重建完工的。 雷鋒塔因為白蛇傳的關係，讓每個中國人都知道西湖有這個雷鋒塔，雷鋒塔的主體，可以搭電梯上去樓上，真的是方便，❤️👍，新的雷鋒塔因為重建的關係還可以上樓參觀，如果現在舊的雷峰塔還存在著，可能就只能在外面看看雷峰塔的主體，所以真的是因禍得福，讓我們可以更親切地，看到整個西湖的景觀跟杭州市景觀。❤️👍 在雷鋒塔的2樓，是一個很推薦的展覽區，用最生動的雕刻方式非常立體呈現白蛇傳的故事，用很細心的方式去參觀，他會覺得他是非常壯觀的。👍👍

Tháp Lôi Phong là một trong những điểm mình thấy đáng ghé khi tham quan Tây Hồ ở Hàng Châu. Đây là bản tháp được trùng tu, nên nhìn khá mới và sạch sẽ, không còn vẻ cổ kính nguyên gốc nhưng lại tiện lợi cho khách tham quan. Bên trong có thang máy đưa lên các tầng, rất phù hợp nếu không muốn leo bộ. Từ trên cao, toàn cảnh Tây Hồ hiện ra rất rõ: mặt hồ rộng, cây xanh bao quanh và những ngôi chùa, ngọn núi phía xa. Cảm giác đứng ở trên nhìn xuống khá thoải mái, nhất là khi thời tiết mát mẻ. Mình đặc biệt thích khoảng thời gian chiều muộn, khi ánh sáng dịu, cảnh hồ và tháp nhìn đẹp hơn nhiều. Tuy nhiên, vì là điểm nổi tiếng nên khách khá đông, nhất là vào cuối tuần. Với mình, đây là một trải nghiệm thực tế, gọn gàng, đáng thử trong hành trình Hàng Châu, không mất nhiều thời gian nhưng để lại ấn tượng rõ rệt.

雷峰塔又名「黃妃塔」，位於西湖南岸夕照山的雷峰上，對面就是淨慈寺（南屏晚鐘）、太子灣公園，是杭州旅遊的熱門地帶。著名的「雷峰夕照」是杭州十景之一，不過看雷峰塔日落的最佳地點並不在景區內，比較推薦的觀景點是附近的長橋，晚霞鍍在塔上，如同佛光普照，非常美。 很多人的「雷峰塔情結」來源於白娘子的傳說，儘管舊塔在1924年就已經倒掉了，如今的雷峰塔是在原來的塔基上新修的，裡面不僅有電梯，還有空調，更像一座博物館，自然也沒有白娘子。但來都來了，沒理由不去看看。 雷峰塔本身是整個景區最大的看點，新修的雷峰塔從底座往上共有5層，檢票後先乘坐電梯（當然也可爬旁邊的樓梯）到塔基遺址，這裡可以看到被玻璃圍起來的舊塔的殘破底座，裡面滿地都是零錢，也算是雷峰塔一景。這一層還有一些地宮出土的文物展，以一座阿育王塔最為精美。 再往上，來到塔的底層，這一層展出的是大型東陽木雕壁畫《白蛇傳》，非常細緻。從這裡繼續往上才開始正式登塔，裡面有步行的樓梯，也有手扶電梯，大多數時候都需要排隊。 塔裡每層樓都展示著一些詩文、壁畫，而大多數人登塔是為了看景。雷峰塔高處的視野很好，不僅可以看西湖全景，還可以俯瞰對面淨慈寺的全貌。尤其是晚上，西湖沿岸的燈光勾勒出整個西湖的輪廓，景色很美。 除了雷峰塔之外，景區內還有夕照亭、妙音台、放生池等小景點。其中，塔前的放生池裡有一塊巨大的假山石，掛滿了被放生的旱龜；佛舍利館裡可看到佛螺髻發舍利。從塔上下來後，可繼續在景區內隨意看看。
オンラインでは中国身分証の入力が必須なので、券売所で普通に券を買ってください。 訪問は平日だったからか、並ぶことなく見て回れました。35度もある暑い日でしたが天気も良く、最上階からの眺めはとてもよかったですよ。 中は土台が浮いてます笑

reviews.text: 雷峰塔 是西湖十景之一，因《白蛇傳》而揚名。 清雍正年間《西湖志》成書，「雷峰夕照」正式成為舉世皆知的「西湖十景」之一。 雷峰塔本身的已成為歷史。據說大家以為雷峰塔的磚可用來驅病強身或安胎，慢慢歲月不饒人，幾乎挖空，塔堪重負在1924倒下來了。 2002重建修好，把原來的舊雷峰塔的遺跡，保存著新塔的1樓2樓，把新的建於原址之上，把舊遺址成為展示廳任人欣賞。 遊人上塔頂可選擇爬樓梯或坐升降機，亦方便傷殘人仕，老人家及小朋友容易登頂， 上到塔頂，慢慢享受著西湖美景。再等待日落西山。 雨天在雷峰塔下看的又會如何？

เจดีย์เหลยเฟิง ริมทะเลสาบตะสันตก ซีหู่ ชมทัศนียภาพของเมืองหางโจวแบบพาโนราม่า รอบทิศทาง รายล้อมด้วยแมกไม้สีสันเปลี่ยนแปลง สวยงามแตกต่างกัน ตามแต่ละฤดู เจดีย์ที่เห็นปัจจุบันสร้างครอบเจดีย์องค์เดิม มีลิฟท์ให้บริการภายในขึ้นชมด้านบน
雷峰塔位於中國浙江省杭州市，為西湖十景之一，原塔已於1924年坍塌，僅存遺址，封存在新塔之下，2002年在原址重建新塔。因《白蛇傳》中作為法海鎮壓白娘子之處而知名於世。 假日來，人超級多
มาช่วงปีใหม่คนเยอะมากๆเดินชมแต่ด้านนอกเพราะ คนต่อแถวซื้อบัตรเบียดกันจนไม่กล้าเข้าไปเบียดด้วยถ้ามีโอกาสจะแวะมาใหม่ในวันที่คนน้อยๆ

塔内部有非常精致的木雕，从塔身往外看的湖景也很美。不过电梯较小，需排队上塔。不坐电梯的话，上下行的楼梯需分开走。 Very exquisive wood sculpture in the pagoda and excellent view of the lake. Crowded elevator, should aware that up and down stairs are separate.
2019/8/19去的時候已經是有改建過的樣貌，整座塔是由朱炳仁設計的銅塔 剛進去的地方可以看到過去坍塌的古蹟，也有一些古蹟的介紹，包含當時坍塌的樣子。 從外面拍照的角度不好抓，會被樹遮住 上塔可以搭電梯或走樓梯，還算滿方便的，只是超多人排隊 上到塔頂可以看到整個西湖的風景，也可以看到南屏晚鐘所在的淨慈寺
在2018/01到訪西湖 原本舊址就已快倒塌,傳說在民初被附近居民謠傳塔磚有神效,居家可鎮邪. 一人一磚給搬倒了,說來有點好笑,可信度頗高.. 來西湖基本上就是會來這,門票40cny,可登塔看遠景,如果遇到下雪天,景色更美,如附檔我所拍的照片
在旧址上重新建了一个新塔。 游客能上去的最高是5层，坐电梯能到4层。 上去可以围着塔外一圈看西湖十景中的九景。塔内每层的文化陈设也值得一逛，有用东阳木雕展现的《白蛇传》，《吴越造塔图》等 节假日不建议来，排很久的队。另外如果想在塔上看西湖的话下雨天视野不好，灰灰的。
雷峰塔景區交通方便，很多公車都有到這邊，雖然塔是重新修建，已經完全沒有古塔的樣子，但塔中的地下室及一樓，有保留當初古塔的遺跡讓人觀看，這邊也是能居高俯瞰整個西湖的制高點，來西湖玩建議要把這邊排進去
雷峰塔原名皇妃塔，文献及民间亦名黄妃塔、王妃塔、黄皮塔，原为五代吴越王钱俶所建供养舍利的佛塔，位于今中国浙江省杭州市西湖区西湖南岸净慈寺前雷峰之上，与北岸宝石山上的保俶塔南北对峙、遥相呼应。原塔于1924年坍塌，仅存遗址，2002年在原址重建新塔。夕阳西下时余晖映照雷峰塔形成著名的雷峰夕照景观，为西湖十景之一。

好幾年前經過此雷峰塔，沒想過要進來，今天母親節帶了岳母逛逛西湖，就進來吧！ 門票40元，為了觀光區旅客的安全，都要安檢，搭了手扶梯直上雷峰塔正南門入口處，一進場可見雷峰塔的舊跡，雷峰塔在1924年坍塌，僅存遺址，2002年在原址重建新塔。夕陽西下時餘暉映照雷峰塔形成著名的雷峰夕照景觀，為西湖十景之一。 當時的出土遺物很多對佛教有極大的貢獻，一二層樓有出土的遺物展覽，坐電梯到頂端可以俯覽西湖整個美景，更可享受徐徐涼風！ 雷峰塔在此矗立近兩千年，與西湖相印成為一個美景，遠觀近賞皆有其獨特性！

雷峰塔の由来となる伝説をあらわした、木彫りの細かさに感動した。 本当に繊細で綺麗。 階段を上りきった最上階の屋根は金ぴかでご利益がありそうだった。 生憎の雨の日だったので、塔からの景色は霞んでしまい、見晴らしが悪かったが幽玄といった感じでそれも味があって良かった。

Hay códigos QR que permiten comprar las entradas online dispersos por el lugar, sin embargo, solo los ciudadanos nativos pueden llegar a realizar esa compra, ya que no dispone de una opción de registro con pasaporte. Aún así, la cola para comprar las entradas en el puesto físico avanza rápido y sin problemas. La entrada cuesta 40元, que son unos 5€. La pagoda es impresionante, muy bonita, y las vistas desde lo alto merecen muchísimo la pena, porque son preciosas. Por dentro hay unos ascensores que te llevan directamente a la planta más alta, sin embargo yo recomiendo subir a pie. Si subes a pie podrás ir más rápido y ver el paisaje en distintos niveles, y además, dentro de los diferentes pisos de la pagoda también hay cosas por dentro, como por ejemplo una pintura que cuenta la historia de la serpiente blanca, o decoraciones. No tengo fotos que muestren lo bonitas que son las vistas desde arriba, pero son muy bonitas.

A Leifeng Pagoda, más néven "Huang Fei” Pagoda egy öt emelet magas, nyolc oldalú torony, amely a Sunset Hillen található, a Nyugati-tó déli partján. Eredetileg 975-ben Qian Chu király parancsára építették kedvenc ágyasa Huang részére. Eredetileg kőalapzatra épült egy tégla szerkezetű, pavilonszerű 5 emeletes torony volt, kívül fa ereszgalériával. Alapja és a toronytest egyenlő oldalú nyolcszög. 1924-ben, a túlzott mértékű téglalopás és feltárás, valamint a közeli építési munkálatok miatt, összeomlott, de 2002-ben újjáépítették.

顺路去了一趟雷峰塔 不会推荐给其他人去了 雷峰塔之所以出名是因为白蛇传 然而这里其实就是一个普通的塔而已 就算里面有一些白蛇传的画 资料什么的。而且 这个雷峰塔是重建的 里面竟然修了电梯 大部分人都是排队乘电梯直接上塔顶 然后走楼梯下来 在塔的底层 可以看到旧址剩下的砖块 算是一种怀念与保护吧 在塔顶可以看到西湖的一些景色 算是唯一一个来雷峰塔的理由了

雖然去旅遊參觀時已是重建新塔，仍是值得一遊景點，尤其周邊也有其他旅遊景點，時間寬裕的話，可以在地多停留幾天，體驗在地風土人情。原為五代吳越王錢俶所建供養舍利的佛塔（功德塔），位於今中國浙江省杭州市西湖區西湖南岸淨慈寺前雷峰之上，與北岸寶石山上的保俶塔南北對峙、遙相呼應。原塔於1924年坍塌，僅存遺址，2002年在原址重建。夕陽西下時餘暉映照雷峰塔形成著名的雷峰夕照景觀，為西湖十景之一。雷峰塔也因在傳說《白蛇傳》中作為法海鎮壓白娘子之處而知名於世。

雷峰塔…沒錯！大家總是很自然的將許仙.白娘子.法海串聯在一塊，而白娘子卻是被法海給鎮壓在雷峰塔底下，永世不得與許仙相見，這淒美的愛情故事，每年總是得讓人讀他那麼一回。 但是神話畢竟只是神話，現實生活當中雷峰塔真正的身世是什麼呢？ 在雷峰塔逐漸要淡出人們的實現之際，一次考古發現，而解開了雷峰塔的身世之謎。 伴隨著2000年杭州市政府對雷峰塔的發掘，一件曠世珍寶被發現。根據當時同時出土的石碑記載，這件東西叫做佛螺髻發，是佛祖釋迦牟尼的頭髮舍利。這也是子啊世界的範圍內，第一次發現的佛祖頭髮舍利。可以想像，這個東西對佛教有著多麼貴重的意義。 所以………故事瞬間幻化成了泡沫？

很久以前曾來過2次 ，這次前來發現入門口要先買票（約40元 ？因為是人家招待的而不太清楚），要安檢（隨身包包要過X光掃描）後再進入 ，上去時新增了電扶梯可省腳力，接者進南門口一及二樓可見舊塔磚塊泥土遺跡 ，再登上一層樓就可到新塔的第一層 ，有直上四樓的電梯但需排長龍 ，建議逐層登樓梯並順道至+1、2、3、4、5樓參觀所展式的木雕及文物等 ，至4或五樓（塔頂）可到門外繞塔俯瞰西湖全景 ，也是去雷峰塔最主要的景與目的 ，然後到四樓若人少搭電梯下至第一層 ，若假日前往要有心理準備會塞車 ，並且景區停車場會爆滿 ，因是新塔而無古蹟之感 ，從西湖各處遠看此塔更有意義 ，特別是晚上塔燈光更是拍照之最佳背景 ，會給三星是因為沒有必要近觀 加上真的要等 ！
